pm-n.label: KKR matches since 2024
pm-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pm-n.query: SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fours, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d2 ON d2.delivery_id = x.delivery_id WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.match_id IN (1422121,1422128,1422134,1426260,1426266,1426269,1426274,1426280,1426285,1426289,1426292,1426298,1426309,1426312,1473438,1473443,1473449,1473452,1473456,1473462,1473468,1473476,1473481,1473485,1473490,1473494,1473505,1527675,1527679,1527685,1527688,1529265,1529268,1529271,1529281,1529288,1529294,1529300,1529303,1529308,1529313) GROUP BY d.match_id
